title: Composite image of a person wearing a virtual reality headset
visual_facts: A smiling older adult in a dark jacket and red tie wears a large white and black visor headset.
A pale classical building facade with columns is layered across the background and the person's face.
The image appears to combine separate photographic elements.
spatial_relations: The headset covers the person's eyes and upper face.
The building facade spans the background and is also faintly superimposed over the portrait.
uncertainties: The image is composited, so it does not document a specific facility or actual VR activity.
The headset's model and the person's identity are not established.
